spec.name: Warforge Dwarf Blacksmith
spec.description: A stout Warcraft-style dwarf blacksmith mid-strike, hammer raised overhead in his right hand and tongs with a glowing rod in his left, working at a rune-marked anvil before a coal forge.
spec.layout: Centered on the dwarf: a short, broad, powerfully built figure about 1.5 m tall standing on the floor facing +Z. His barrel torso sits low on stubby sturdy legs in heavy boots; a huge braided copper-red beard hangs from a broad ruddy face under a simple steel cap with side hair tufts and a thick nose. His right arm is raised high overhead gripping a massive two-handed hammer with a glowing blue rune on its head; his left arm reaches forward and down holding blacksmith tongs gripping a small glowing iron rod. In front of him at +Z rests the anvil on a knotted oak stump, its face glowing faintly where the work sits; behind him at -Z stands a squat stone forge with a glowing coal bed, a stub chimney and a side rack of tools. Every part is bold blocky low-poly silhouette: chunky limbs, big hands and boots, a hammer head nearly as large as the anvil face, thick beard wedges with braid rings, warm firelight colours (ember orange and gold) picked out against cool stone, steel and iron, with glowing parts (forge coals, hammer rune, hot rod, anvil hot spot) reading instantly as the light source of the scene.

parts.builds: The dwarf's stocky core riding hips, spine and chest: a wide barrel torso built as a tapered loft/frustum (shoulders broader than the waist, belly pushing forward) in tunic blue with a darker shadowed underside. Over it a full-length blacksmith's apron in worn leather hangs chest to shin, with a brass buckle plate on the chest strap, a waist belt of leather with a big round brass buckle at the front, and a stitched hem band in leatherDark along the apron bottom. A thick leather shoulder strap crosses the chest diagonally holding a small back pouch. Beneath the tunic edge a strip of dark under-shirt shows at the collar and at the cuffs the arms part builds. Add a chunky neck base, small bronze shoulder plates on the chest, a leather mitten loop and pouch at the hip, and a warm rim of firelight (ember-tinted small parts) on the side facing the forge. Rests on the hip joints over the legs part.
parts.attaches: Sits over hipsSocket (legs part below) and under neckBase and both shoulders; apron bottom overlaps the legs part's thigh tops.

parts.builds: The dwarf's head and signature beard riding neck, head and jaw: a big blocky skull (scaled box/sphere) in skin, flat wide face with a huge round nose part in nose colour, two small deep-set eyes (dark eye spheres with pale brow-ridge strips above), heavy angled brows in hairDark, a wide open grin mouth in mouth colour on the jaw with a few blocky teeth, and big pointed ears sticking out sideways in skin with darker inner ears. The identity feature: a massive braided beard in beard colour built as broad overlapping wedges from cheeks down past the chest, with a central braid column, two side braids each tipped with a brass ring, a lighter beardLight top edge, and a separate moustache wedge over the mouth. Hair tufts in hairDark stick out under a simple dented steel cap with a steelDark band and a small brass rivet row; a brass hoop earring hangs from one ear. Nothing covers the face; cap, ears and hair sit above and beside it.
parts.attaches: Mounts on neckBase; beard drapes forward over the torso part's chest; jaw hinge sits inside the head part's lower front.

parts.builds: Both arms, hands and tools, riding shoulderL/elbowL/handL and shoulderR/elbowR/handR. Right arm raised overhead in a mid-swing pose: thick upper arm and forearm in tunic blue with rolled cuff strips in leather, steel elbow pad, big leather glove hand (chunky mitten-fist of two blocks with a thumb) gripping at hammerGrip a massive two-handed smith's hammer: a long wood handle wrapped with leatherDark grip bands, ending in an oversized iron hammer head of frustum boxes with a steel striking face on both ends, a brass collar where head meets handle, and a glowing runeBlue rune plate inlaid in the cheek of the head (glow). Left arm reaches forward and down: same arm construction, glove holding at tongsGrip a pair of long black iron tongs (two thin rods with a hinged pivot disc) gripping a short glowing rod that fades iron to emberCore at its tip (glow). Add a small leather bracer stud row on each forearm and a shoulder pauldron cap of steel where each arm meets the torso mounts.
parts.attaches: Pauldrons cap shoulderL and shoulderR on the torso part; glove R clamps hammerGrip; glove L meets tongsGrip reaching toward anvilWorkFace.

parts.builds: The dwarf's short powerful legs riding hipL/kneeL/ankleL and hipR/kneeR, planted slightly apart on the floor: thick trousered thighs and shins in leatherDark with a tunic-blue knee patch, tapering into enormous heavy smith's boots in boot leather: wide rounded toe boxes pointing +Z with steel toe caps, stacked leather soles in leatherDark resting flat on y = 0, a folded boot cuff at the ankle with a small brass buckle, and a steel knee pad dome on each knee. A hint of striped sock or boot tongue in a lighter tone peeks at the cuff. Feet are the model's floor contact for the figure.
parts.attaches: Thigh tops plug up into hipsSocket under the torso part's apron; soles rest on the floor mount; boots sit behind the anvil part's stump.

parts.builds: The work station in front of the dwarf at +Z: a knotted oak stump in wood with woodDark bark rings on its side and a visible top ring pattern of concentric wood discs, carrying a classic blacksmith anvil in dark iron: a long body with a waist, a broad flat top face with a bright ember-glowing hot spot (glow) where the glowing rod would land, a conical horn pointing +X, a thicker heel block at -X with a round hardy hole, and a steel plate pad under the base. Along the stump front edge a small iron tool rack with a punch, a flatter and a cut hardy tool stuck upright, and one pair of tongs laid across the stump corner. Two little rivet plates where the anvil feet meet the stump. This part is a static prop with no joints.
parts.attaches: Stump base rests on the floor mount in front of the legs part; anvil top face sits at anvilWorkFace facing the dwarf; the left hand's tongsGrip hovers just above its face.

parts.builds: The squat stone forge behind the dwarf at -Z: a blocky stone hearth of stacked, slightly offset stone blocks in stone with stoneDark mortar gaps, an open front firebox facing +Z with a glowing coal bed inside (ember and emberCore lumps with coal darks, glowing, the scene's main light), iron fire bars across the front, a thick iron hood and a stub square chimney with a small brass trim band and a thin wisp of three stacked smoke puffs in pale grey perched above. To the forge's side a leaning rack: a wooden post and crossbar holding a long poker, a shovel and a rake with iron heads, plus a leather bellows (two wedge boards with a brass nozzle) propped against the hearth, and a small pile of coal lumps spilling at its base. A few scattered embers (tiny glowing cubes) dot the hearth lip. Static prop with no joints.
parts.attaches: Base rests on the floor mount behind the dwarf; its firebox mouth at forgeFace faces the dwarf's back and lights the torso part's rear side.
